1. Local-First Pantry & Inventory Storage\nPantryPulse stores your fridge inventory, expiry countdowns, owned appliances, spice rack preferences, and restock list locally on your device using Android Room Database and Jetpack DataStore. Your inventory works 100% offline.

2. Camera & Photo Picker Usage\nWhen you use Fridge Vision or Receipt Scan, you may capture a photo via CameraX (android.permission.CAMERA) or select photos using the zero-permission Android Photo Picker. Images are downscaled on-device (<=896px) before being sent to Firebase AI Logic (Gemini) solely to identify ingredients and estimate freshness.

3. Voice Dictation & Speech Output\nVoice-to-Inventory and Sous-Chef voice queries use Android\'s system Speech Recognizer (RecognizerIntent) only when you tap the microphone button. Hands-free recipe reading uses on-device Android TextToSpeech.

4. Zero-Cost Local Mode & Data Control\nYou can enable Zero-Cost Local Mode (Tier 3) at any time so 100% of shelf check-ins, recipe synthesis, and Sous-Chef responses run locally on your device with zero cloud requests. You can delete any inventory item or clear chat history at any time.
